status: Provisional answer rubric, AI-drafted by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-11-14 from the text of the two hash-verified BAG commentaries, before any answer was generated. Pending Erhan's review: no claim, support quote, check term or expected status here has been checked by a person. It must not be extended or relaxed from model outputs.

rules.required_claims: What a complete answer must state. Each has support quotes (edition, PDF page, verbatim text) that the run checks against the corpus; a claim is available to the generator only when a passage covering its support is in the request's context.
rules.check_terms: Optional deterministic term check: every group needs one of its variants in the answer's claim texts (NFC, case-folded, whitespace folded, decimal comma read as point). null means the claim is semantic and left to human review. A passing term check is not semantic validation (a negated or misattributed statement can pass it).
rules.optional_background: Statements an answer may add; never required, never scored.
rules.expected_status: The status an answer should have if all evidence were retrieved. For D1 the retrieval at k=5 misses the evidence, so its scoring reports the retrieval miss and the generator's behaviour separately.
rules.insufficient_evidence: For U1 and U2 it means the selected commentary edition does not state the answer, not that no tariff or change exists.
